resources.string: There are no release notes for this version.
Tap Edit to reorder your shortcuts. Open recent documents from Home or tap the big Scan button to start a new one.
Hold steady until the outline turns green, then take the shot.
Shaded boxes and coloured labels keep their look in cleaned-up scans.
Tap Text on a page to copy words. Search finds English and Bengali words inside scans.
Choose Sign PDF on Home, or tap Sign in the page editor.
Choose and reorder export steps before saving. Password protection always runs last.
Edit each side and drag each card into position on the page. Add more than two sides when you need them.
Drag the page tag on the right edge of the Reader to jump between pages.
Choose a default filter and straightening setting in Settings. In review, use Apply to all pages to make the same change across a scan.
Open Updates in Settings to install a new version of Scanly.
Zoom into a scanned page and Scanly loads it at full resolution, so small print stays crisp.
The update dialog formats headings, lists and bold text.
Scanly takes 4 MB less to download and install.
